title: 2011 AMC 10B Problem 10
statement: Consider the set of numbers \(\{1, 10, 10^2, 10^3, \ldots, 10^{10}\}.\) The ratio of the largest element of the set to the sum of the other ten elements of the set is closest to which integer?

solutions.text:
The largest number is \(10^{10}.\) The other ten numbers have sum \[S=\sum_{i=0}^9 10^i=\dfrac{10^{10}-1}{9}.\] Therefore their ratio is \[\dfrac{10^{10}}{S}=9\cdot\dfrac{10^{10}}{10^{10}-1},\] which is just slightly greater than \(9\) and hence closest to \(9.\)

Thus, the correct answer is B .
hints: The denominator is a geometric sum
